blocks.value: Sometimes a stock moves beyond its support or resistance level. These important movements are called Breakouts and Breakdowns.
Imagine This: A locked door blocks your path. Once the door opens, you can move freely into the next room. A breakout is similar—the stock moves beyond a level that was previously stopping it.
A Breakout happens when the price moves above resistance. A Breakdown happens when the price falls below support.
A stock trades below ₹1,000 for several weeks. One day it closes at ₹1,030 with strong volume. This may be a breakout.
⚠️ Not every breakout succeeds. Some fail and quickly reverse direction.
Many traders wait for confirmation before acting on a breakout.
